note: Taught: the Preamble itself states the Constitution was adopted on 26 November 1949.
Taught: the Constitution came into force on 26 January 1950 (Art 394; the commencement of the Constitution).
Taught: the Constituent Assembly adopted the Constitution on 26 November 1949.
Taught: members of the Constituent Assembly were chosen by indirect election by the members of the Provincial Legislative Assemblies under the Government of India Act, 1935.

Taught: the demand for a Constitution was reiterated by Nehru at the Congress Faizpur session on 27 December 1936; the chapter also teaches Gandhi first raised the demand in 1922, so among the given options the 1936 Congress demand is the keyed answer.

Taught: Fundamental Duties (Art 51A) were inserted by the 42nd Amendment, 1976 (w.e.f. 3-1-1977), so they were not in the Constitution as adopted in 1949. Note: the paper prints the completion date as 29.11.1949; the Constitution was adopted on 26.11.1949. POL-02 also teaches Fundamental Duties.
Taught: the Constitution of India was adopted on 26 November 1949.
Taught: the Constitution of India came into force on 26 January 1950.
Not taught: 'Political Justice' as a Preamble term belongs to POL-02 (Preamble), not to this chapter on constitution-making.
Not taught: the Charter Act of 1853 belongs to the pre-1947 Acts, owned by History HIS-27; this chapter mentions only the GOI Act 1935 and the Independence Act 1947 in brief.
Not taught: the first Public Service Commission under the GOI Act 1919 belongs to the pre-1947 Acts, owned by History HIS-27.
Not taught: 'Socialist' and 'Secular' added to the Preamble by the 42nd Amendment belongs to POL-02 (Preamble); this chapter teaches only that Art 51A came via the 42nd Amendment.
